summary: Consultant isolation fix verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/11 pass (1 unrelated seed-data drift in preview consultant assignments, not a code bug). Consultant A (role=admin + is_consultant=true) via signup: sees only own client, staff's client + asset hidden, GET/PUT/DELETE staff client -> 403, POST /api/data/clients with consultant_id=other -> 403. Staff consultant sees only its own client. FINORA admin ryuichi (no is_consultant) still sees all 4+ tenant clients. Preview client sees only own record. Frontend preview: fresh signup consultant sees only 'A顧客UI' on /clients page and header client selector shows '全顧客 (1)' (no cross-tenant leakage). Production smoke: demo-consultant@finora.co.jp login OK, /api/data/clients returns 3 assigned clients (Ana Paula Ferreira, 山本 美咲, 佐藤 健一). No prod writes.

minor.issue: Preview consultant@finora.co.jp assigned clients are actually [佐藤 健一, 山本 美咲, Ana Paula Ferreira] (ノヴァテック not currently assigned). test_credentials.md still lists ノヴァテック. Not a code bug — update the memory file or reassign the seed.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> inserted inside <option> by the x-source-editable devtools instrumentation. Harmless in production but noisy in preview console.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect actual preview consultant assigned clients (山本 美咲 in place of ノヴァテック) OR re-seed to match documented list.
critical_code_review_comments: core.sees_all + accessible_ids + scope + crud.check_write/delete_entity correctly restrict is_consultant admins to only their own clients (consultant_id == self or in secondary_consultant_ids), same rule path as staff consultants.

crud.create_entity sets consultant_id=self for is_consultant admins because check_write enforces sees_all(user) OR doc.consultant_id == user.id. Verified 403 when admin-is-consultant tries to assign a client to another user.

crud.update_entity for clients pops consultant_id only when role=='consultant' — is_consultant admin can therefore still transfer ownership away from themselves via PUT; consider blocking or defaulting consultant_id updates for is_consultant admins too.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Ad-hoc signups used unique @example.test emails, cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 1 signup tenant + 1 staff user + 1 client + 1 asset created per pytest run and deleted in fixture teardown. 1 UI-test signup tenant created and manually deleted after browser test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup rate-limited to 5/IP/hour. Each pytest run consumes 1 slot. If 429, wait or reduce runs. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_consultant_isolation.py covers isolation for is_consultant admins + staff consultants + regression for FINORA admin/consultant/client.
rca of the issue: Original bug: is_consultant admins had role=='admin' so sees_all returned True everywhere, leaking other consultants' clients. Fix: core.sees_all now returns admin AND NOT is_consultant; accessible_ids/scope treat is_consultant admins with the same query as staff consultants (consultant_id or secondary_consultant_ids). crud.check_write and delete_entity gate writes/deletes on `sees_all(user) or doc.consultant_id == user.id`. Verified with 8 dedicated tests.
